persons.name: Padmākarasiṃha
persons.evidence: likhite yaṃ thahiti jyāthabāhārayā śrīvajrācāryya padmākarasiṃhana || thva pustaka dayekā jula

notes: Although the catalogue record identified Thahiti kvāthavahāra / Jyāthabāhāra (Kathmandu) as the place of copying, the colophon specifies that the manuscript was written in Lhasa ('hlāsadesaḥ hlājusāvāgrahe coyā jula') by or for Padmākarasiṃha of Jyāthabāhāra, Thahiti, Kathmandu (Yaṃ).
